lines.trans: Everyone get ready—we start working in just a moment.
The word unreliable has never had anything to do with him in his entire life, right?
Hearing him say that felt mighty strange to me too.
So falling in love with someone can change a person like this.
He has changed completely from head to toe.
Xin Huimei is the kind of woman who can make any man fall under her spell.
Wen Simo was like that, and who knew even our boss would be too.
Sister Xingzi, you are still pretty fortunate.
At the very least, Mr Wen Simo is still single, right?
Xiaogu, the boss is waving for you to come over.
